description: A dark olive-green knee-length tunic with subtle woven texture and gold knotwork borders at cuffs and hem, over an ivory collar. A heavy green-gray wool mantle with patterned gold edging and fringes wraps the shoulders and is fastened by a round bronze brooch. A brown leather belt with round bronze medallion buckle and an ornate long hanging end encircles the waist. Brown trousers and tall brown leather boots with crossed calf straps complete the outfit. No armor or headgear.
